messages:
sasha: Heads-up — iterating on the synthetic generator for the kernel-selection perf tests. Need quick feedback on KV-warmup timing and burst shaping. Passing the config below to the harness, @oliver @maria :eyes:

oliver: Quick q — are we still running the linear-ramp + burst-spike combo? last run showed a weird long-tail bump during bursts.

maria: I saw that. On the probe VM the KV hitrate drops from ~96% to ~60% during the first 100-150ms of the spike window. That correlates with larger batch formation delays.

sasha: Yup. Proposed changes: add a short prewarm that targets the top-10 prefixes, and switch batching heuristic to `latency-first` for the explicit spike window. Config I'm testing: 
```json
{
  "shape": "ramp-then-spike",
  "ramp": {"start_qps": 10, "end_qps": 500, "duration_s": 120},
  "spike": {"qps": 2500, "duration_s": 20, "pattern": "poisson_peak"},
  "kv": {"prewarm_top_k": 10, "prefetch_budget_ms": 150},
  "batching": {"default": "throughput-first", "spike_window": "latency-first"},
  "kernel": {"pin": true, "choice": "int8-fused-attn-v2"}
}
```

jamie: SGTM. Also can we pin kernel to `int8-fused-attn-v2` for apples-to-apples with previous A/B? last autoswitch introduced a regression and made comparison noisy.

oliver: Agree. Plan: 3 runs — (1) baseline autoswitch, (2) pinned int8, (3) pinned fp16. Keep sequence length distribution and payloads identical for all runs (use replay harness seed 42).

ci-bot: loadgen-bot queued job 9876 with config `ramp-curator-202503.json` (run 1 baseline).

maria: Quick dev-box numbers from an earlier probe: baseline P99=420ms, pinned-int8 P99=310ms but noticed P50 regressed ~+5ms. That suggests batching overhead on small requests. Need batch-size histogram + kernel timing breakdown.

sasha: On it — enabling the per-batch profiler and request-size histogram. Also toggling KV prefetch to use 80% of the prewarm budget to reduce cold misses in the first spike.

jamie: If P50 regresses, maybe latency-first heuristic is causing extra micro-batches for small fanout requests. Might want a hybrid: latency-first only when queue depth > X or during the first Y ms of the spike.

oliver: Makes sense. Can you add a flag `spike_hybrid_threshold` to the config so we can sweep?

sasha: Will do. Adding `spike_hybrid_threshold_ms: 40` and a `batch_size_cutoff` metric in the profiler.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: loadgen job 9876 started on pool `dev-us-west-1`.

maria: Please make sure kernel is pinned for run 2/3 as discussed. Also capture KV miss traces and attach `kv-misses.tar.gz` to run artifacts.

sasha: Kicking off run 2 (pinned int8) now. I'll paste run IDs and link to artifacts when available.

sasha: run 1 id=9876, run 2 id=9877, run 3 id=9878. Attaching preliminary P99 numbers to the job pages once jobs complete.

oliver: Thanks — once we have all three, let's do an apples-to-apples table (same seeds, same kernel pins where applicable) and check regression owners if any perf inverted. 30m sync?

sasha: 30m works for me. :thumbsup:
